is_anopheles.evidence: Studies field-collected Anopheles gambiae s.s. and Anopheles arabiensis (Page 1, Abstract).

reports_target_markers.evidence: Genotypes for Vgsc L1014F (L995F) and L1014S (L995S) (Page 1, Abstract; Page 7, Tables 1 and 2).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Tables 1 and 2 (Page 7 and 8) provide explicit genotype counts (S/S, S/RE, RE/RE, RE/RW) for 290 An. gambiae s.s. and 183 An. arabiensis.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected in seven sites throughout Uganda from March 2001 to February 2002 (Page 2, Methods).

is_primary_study.evidence: Primary empirical research paper describing a new FRET/MCA assay and applying it to field-collected mosquitoes.

sub_country_location.evidence: Genotype results are aggregated at the country level for Uganda; specific names or breakdown for the seven collection sites are not given.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected from March 2001 to February 2002 (1-year period) (Page 2, Methods).

duplicate_risk.evidence: Field samples were collected during an unpublished transmission study in Uganda (Okello, unpublished data) and genotyped here for the first time.

supplement.evidence: All core genotype data and method comparison tables are contained within the main text (Tables 1 and 2).

assessment.summary: This methodological study evaluated a novel FRET/Melt Curve Analysis (FRET/MCA) assay against standard AS-PCR for detecting Vgsc L1014F and L1014S kdr mutations in 290 Anopheles gambiae s.s. and 183 Anopheles arabiensis field specimens collected in Uganda between March 2001 and February 2002. Extractable genotype counts for both markers are reported.
